oil.when: 2011–2012 using the Driver Information Center buttons or the trip odometer stem
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Bring up OIL LIFE REMAINING on the Driver Information Center. Without DIC buttons, shift to Park first so the reading can be shown.
Press and hold the SET/RESET button, or the trip odometer reset stem if there are no DIC buttons, for more than five seconds.
Let go when the oil life reads 100%. If CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON comes back at the next start, repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2011 and 2012 owner's manuals.

oil.when: 2011–2012 accelerator pedal method (works on every Tahoe)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON/RUN with the engine off.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way to the floor three times within five seconds.
Bring up OIL LIFE REMAINING on the Driver Information Center. If it reads 100%, the reset worked.
If CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON comes back at the next start, or oil life stays near 0%, repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2011 Tahoe/Suburban and 2012 Tahoe owner's manuals.

notes: The oil life system does not reset itself, so reset it after every oil change, even an early one.
